ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black and dark-brown pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field bounded by thick black peripheral margins. The left lobe features one isolated orange-brown circular focal spot in the upper-mid quadrant. Dark pixels extend from the peduncle base into the median notch.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry; the right lobe displays a significantly higher density of non-white/non-black pixel clusters (yellow-brown) compared to the left lobe.
